why: We want AI to take paperwork off your plate. We want to protect families, students and donors, and keep mistakes from going out under our name.
who_it_covers: All staff, volunteers, contractors and board members.

tools.name: Microsoft Copilot
tools.approved_for: Pilot users (eight licenses): donor names and gift amounts. No case file or student information.

tools.name: ChatGPT
tools.approved_for: Work email only. Nothing about a real person goes in.

new_tools: Luis approves any new tool, plugin, AI agent or AI feature in software we own. Anything touching client data also needs Grace, our compliance director.
accounts: Use your work email, and turn off any setting that trains on what you type.
everyone_now: Anyone may use ChatGPT for work with no information about a real person in it. Copilot pilot users may do the same with Copilot.
allowed_uses: Everyone: reword an email, brainstorm, or explain a form.
Teachers: lesson plans, reading passages, GED practice questions, and Spanish handout translations. No student names or scores.
Copilot pilot users (development team and Luis): draft appeals and thank-you letters with donor names; summarize grant guidelines.

needs_approval.use: AI-drafted text in county contract reports or funder grant reports
Any AI use with client data

protected_information: Case files (county contract): names, addresses, income, immigration status, domestic violence, mental health and substance use notes. Student records (district agreement): names, grades, scores, attendance. Donor notes. Staff files. Passwords and login details.
off_limits: Installing a browser plugin that reads your email.
Using AI to score intake essays or place adult students in class levels.
AI-written public statements about the news, or an AI photo passed off as one of our families.
check_before_it_goes_out: A person reads everything AI helps write: facts, names, numbers, tone. Check county report numbers against our records. The sender is responsible.
decisions_about_people: AI never decides who gets emergency assistance funds. Caseworkers and their supervisor decide. AI may only help with wording or ideas.
being_open: A person signs thank-you letters. Label materials AI helped make, like reading passages. Answer funders honestly when they ask about AI.
if_something_goes_wrong: Tell Luis and Grace the same day. For client data, Grace decides if it is a breach. Reporting a mistake is expected, not punished.
who_owns_this: Luis keeps this policy current and runs an hour of training. The board approves changes. We review it in 12 months.
open_questions: Should we buy ChatGPT Team, extend Copilot to everyone, or neither?
May AI help with case notes, and what does the county allow?
Will we approve Canva's AI image tools, which communications uses now?
